7,561 likes, 65 comments - techplusgadgets on September 27, 2026: "It’s a wrap on Meta Connect 2026 🎬

Three days at Menlo Park, front row for the keynote, and hands on everything before the world saw it.

What Zuck dropped:
👓 Meta VR Glasses — ultralight, just 100g on your face
🕶️ Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 — new styles, out now

From Bhopal to Menlo Park thank you for making this possible ❤️ @meta @metaindia @muse 

#MetaConnect #TechPlusGadgets #AIGlasses #Meta #TechCreator".

7,920 likes, 344 comments - techplusgadgets on October 16, 2024: "Pichle saal ki tarh is saal bhi FORBES me aa gaye, Yeh sab ap logo ki wajh se 🔥😍

A middle-class boy from a small town, on the @forbesindia Top 100 Digital Creators list—first in 2023, and now again in 2024. I still can’t believe it! Honestly, never thought I would come this far, but hard work, patience, and persistence made it possible. 💯

This is just the beginning. If I can make it, you can too! It’s not about where you start but about how much you’re willing to push yourself every day. 🛤️

Kasam se bas lage rahoo 💪

Grateful for every challenge and every person who supported me on this journey. Let’s keep breaking barriers together!🚀 

I Promise you i’ll work super hard and provide you tech information, all for many more years to come! ✨

#DreamBig #HardWorkPaysOff #ForbesTop100 #KeepGoing #techplusgadgets".

🚨 Dosto, iss scam se bachkar rehna!

Agar aapko 10-digit mobile number se money transfer ka SMS aaye, toh trust mat karna

Banks ke transaction SMS usually official sender IDs se aate hain, normal personal mobile numbers se nahi.

Unknown links par click mat karo aur kisi ko bhi paise return karne se pehle payment verify zarur karo.
